run_response_evaluation_cli: run the response evaluation CLI to compute BLEU scores between model predictions and ground truth responses
evaluate_response_generation: evaluate response generation by computing BLEU scores between ground truth and model-generated responses
normalize_sentence: normalize and tokenize a sentence by lowercasing and applying NLTK word tokenization
run_single_round_bleu_evaluation: run single-round BLEU evaluation on the last turn of each dialogue for hidden split testing
record_instance_bleu_results: record per-instance BLEU scores and response lengths to a JSON output file
